_comment: Photos a photo-band pin may use (scripts/pinterest/quality.mjs photoIssue). Free licences only: Unsplash (free licence, never Unsplash+), Pexels or Pixabay. Each entry: file (under public/pins/photos/), licence (unsplash|pexels|pixabay), source_url (the photo page), photographer, photographer_url, watermark (false once checked by eye). The file must be at least 1000px wide. None in use yet: the approved brand (spry brain, 6 Nov 2026) says no stock photos, so pins show the letter or checklist itself.
